extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended pertuzumab, within its marketing authorisation, with intravenous trastuzumab and chemotherapy, for the adjuvant treatment of HER2-positive early stage breast cancer at high risk of recurrence in adults with lymph node-positive disease. Pertuzumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS. This indication is based on APHINITY (BO25126), a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial. Investigators selected one of the following chemotherapy regimens: (i) 3 or 4 cycles of FEC or 5-fluorouracil, doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide (FAC), followed by 3 or 4 cycles of docetaxel or 12 cycles of weekly paclitaxel; (ii) 4 cycles of AC or epirubicin and cyclophosphamide (EC), followed by 3 or 4 cycles of docetaxel or 12 cycles of weekly paclitaxel; or (iii) 6 cycles of docetaxel in combination with carboplatin.
